# graphql-middleware

Install: npm install @ferrow/graphql-middleware
> GraphQL operation guard for a supplied AST: fragment-aware depth limit with cycle guard, per-field complexity scoring, operation allowlist/denylist, and introspection blocking. graphql-js is optional — accepts its document shape structurally, zero hard dependencies.

A GraphQL operation guard that works on an already-parsed AST. It doesn't execute your schema and it doesn't require `graphql-js` — it accepts any object matching graphql-js's `DocumentNode` shape structurally, so if you

## API
- `guardOperation`
- `measureDepth`
- `computeComplexity`
- `usesIntrospection`
- `buildFragmentMap`
- `FragmentCycleError`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
